slot.subtopic: Range of a sin + b cos
slot.brief: Find the range or maximum/minimum of an expression of the form a sin θ + b cos θ + c using the amplitude bound √(a² + b²).

verdicts.working: The interior critical point satisfies (sinθ, cosθ)=(3/5,4/5), giving the maximum value 7. At the endpoints, the values are 6 and −2, so the range is [−2,7].

working:
Let $\cos\varphi=\dfrac{3}{5}$, $\sin\varphi=\dfrac{4}{5}$, $0<\varphi<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$. Then $3\sin\theta+4\cos\theta=5\sin(\theta+\varphi)$; $\theta+\varphi\in[\varphi,\pi+\varphi]$, so $\sin(\theta+\varphi)\in\left[-\dfrac{4}{5},1\right]$. Hence the range is $[2-4,2+5]=[-2,7]$.

Independent check: The interior critical point satisfies (sinθ, cosθ)=(3/5,4/5), giving the maximum value 7. At the endpoints, the values are 6 and −2, so the range is [−2,7].
solution:
Write $3\sin\theta+4\cos\theta=5\sin(\theta+\varphi)$, where $\cos\varphi=\frac35$ and $\sin\varphi=\frac45$. Since $\theta+\varphi\in[\varphi,\pi+\varphi]$, its sine ranges from $-\frac45$ to $1$.
$$2+5\left[-\frac45,1\right]=[-2,7]$$
